Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

Search-PI · has stage: Meta states that Search-PI Complex was developed with Trajectory Labs, which pre-generated injections using its proprietary attacker for multi-location attacks; the report includes 30 benign-malicious task pairs and reserves remaining tasks as held-out.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.search-pi.complex-construction.v2

  • Trajectory Labs’ contribution is limited to the explicitly described Complex subset; it is not generalized to every Meta benchmark or the Simple subset.
  • The private attacker, held-out tasks and full corpus were not accessed, and no open payload license is inferred.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

Search-PI · benchmark task: Meta’s Search-PI method evaluates prompt-injection attacks on an information-seeking assistant using web search, open and find tools with simulated personal information; Simple uses live web search while Complex uses a mock search index built from cached web content.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.search-pi.environment.v2

  • This describes the public report’s bounded Search-PI method, not the entire SIREN suite, actual personal-data exfiltration or a performed attack here.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

Search-PI · documents: For Search-PI Complex, the report’s pass@5 procedure repeats the same static attack five times because only outputs of the proprietary attacker are available.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.search-pi.repeated-static-limit.v2

  • This is not five newly adapted attack strategies; Simple’s adaptive-attempt procedure is a different setting.
  • No performance ordering or operational security guarantee is proposed.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

Search-PI · evaluates: The Search-PI Simple method evaluates each task pair with four handcrafted static injection templates and with an LLM attacker making six adaptive attempts, yielding 480 static and 720 adaptive evaluations per model.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.search-pi.simple-attacker-regimes.v2

  • These are documented evaluation budgets, not counts of unique logical benchmark families or an independent attack-success measurement.

Search-PI · dataset size: Search-PI Simple combines 10 benign SimpleQA tasks with 12 malicious tasks into 120 task pairs in the documented evaluation.
